commands.summary: How the posts of the last days are doing: views, likes and comments on each platform (Threads’ and X’s replies count as comments, Pinterest’s reactions as likes), as Upload-Post reads them from the platforms. The Monday numbers are `social scorecard`.

options.description: Posts from this many days back (default 7).

commands.name: social snapshot
commands.summary: Every number Upload-Post gives, appended to .studio/social/metrics.jsonl as it is read (and its copy on ops-history): the accounts and TikTok’s bio-link taps, then each finished public post up to 15 days old (every one on Mondays), a line per platform. Reads only; posts nothing.

options.description: Read every finished post, however old, as Mondays do.
Show what would be read, and stop. Needs no key and writes nothing.

commands.name: social scorecard
commands.summary: The Monday numbers, from what `social snapshot` kept: per platform, posts, median views at a fixed age (72 h; YouTube 7 days, Pinterest 14), TikTok’s hold at 3 s, taps toward the App Store, followers and breakouts (5× the last 14 posts, and 1,000 views), with App Store Connect’s numbers when .studio/ops/acquisition.json has them. Calls nothing.

options.description: The window, in days back from now (default 7).

commands.name: social status
commands.summary: Where the last posts are: asks Upload-Post about any not yet finished, and lists each platform’s link or error.

options.description: How many posts to show (default 5).
Ask again about every post shown, finished or not.

commands.name: voice status
commands.summary: The speech server, the voice cast as Lina, and what has been recorded.

commands.name: voice list
commands.summary: The candidates for Lina’s voice, and which one is cast.

options.description: Also list each voice’s recordings, with the ids `voice freeze --take` wants.

commands.name: voice cast
commands.summary: Cast a voice as Lina. Every lesson is narrated with it from then on.

commands.name: voice add
commands.summary: Add a candidate voice.

options.description: What to call it, which also becomes its id.
chatterbox, qwen-design or qwen-custom.
For qwen-custom: Vivian, Serena, Ryan, Aiden, Dylan, Eric, Uncle_Fu, Ono_Anna or Sohee.
Who she is (qwen-design) or how she delivers the line (qwen-custom).
One line about the personality, for the card.

commands.name: voice say
commands.summary: Have one voice read a line. The take already made for those words is reused.

options.description: Write the audio here as a WAV file.
Make a new take even though one exists.

commands.name: voice freeze
commands.summary: Upload one take as this voice’s reference, so it stops varying between takes.

options.description: The take to freeze from (see `voice list --takes`). 5–15 seconds is ideal.

commands.name: voice unfreeze
commands.summary: Let a frozen voice vary again, and take its record out of shared/. The reference stays on the speech server.

commands.name: voice narrate
commands.summary: Record every step of a lesson that has no recording or an out-of-date one, or of every lesson with --all.

options.description: Record every step again, even the ones that are ready.
Every lesson in the working library, drafts included, in curriculum order.

commands.name: voice lines set
commands.summary: Write the line a step speaks, instead of its written instruction (at most 240 characters).

commands.name: voice lines clear
commands.summary: Go back to speaking the step’s written instruction.

commands.name: voice publish
commands.summary: Write a lesson’s narration into shared/Assets/Voice/ as AAC files and a manifest, or every ready lesson with --all.

options.description: Every published lesson whose narration is complete, and Lina’s own lines; the rest are listed with the reason.

commands.name: voice unpublish
commands.summary: Remove a lesson’s narration from shared/. The recordings stay in the workspace.

commands.name: voice lines list
commands.summary: What Lina says at each step: the written line, or the instruction she falls back to.

commands.name: voice lines generate
commands.summary: Have a model write what Lina says at each step: one or two spoken sentences instead of the written instruction.

options.description: What to change this time, in a sentence.
Replace the lines already written, instead of only filling the rest.
Say what would be sent to the model, and stop.

commands.name: voice lines apply
commands.summary: Write the spoken lines of a whole lesson from a plan: { "lines": { "<step>": "…" | null } }.

options.description: The plan JSON, as `voice lines list --json` prints it.

commands.name: voice reference export
commands.summary: Keep a frozen voice’s reference recording in shared/Assets/VoiceReference/, so Lina survives a wiped machine.

commands.name: voice reference restore
commands.summary: Put a frozen voice back from shared/: upload its reference to the speech server and return it to the workspace.

commands.name: voice app list
commands.summary: Lina’s own lines: what the app says outside any lesson, and what is recorded for each.

commands.name: voice app set
commands.summary: Rewrite one of the app’s lines (at most 240 characters). The id is fixed: hello, lesson-1, lesson-2, lesson-3, lesson-4, path-1, path-2, path-3, path-4, paths-welcome.

commands.name: voice app narrate
commands.summary: Record every one of Lina’s own lines that has no recording or an out-of-date one.

options.description: Record every line again, even the ones that are ready.

commands.name: voice app publish
commands.summary: Write Lina’s own lines into shared/Assets/Voice/app/ as AAC files and a manifest.

commands.name: voice app unpublish
commands.summary: Remove Lina’s own lines from shared/. The recordings stay in the workspace.

commands.name: voice script
commands.summary: The audition lines every voice reads.

commands.name: voice script set
commands.summary: Change one audition line, or add it.

options.description: What to call the line (default: its id, or what it was called).
